QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Shrine Tales] The Bachelor's Request
QuestInfo.0: The coy looking Bachelor Specter seems to be eying you. You should talk with it.
QuestInfo.1: The Bachelor Specter is looking for #t4034858#. They ask you to recover it by any means necessary... Perhaps the Specters or Skeletal Samurai wandering around have a copy.
QuestInfo.2: You gave #t4034858# to the Bachelor Specter. It seemed disappointed with #t4034858# and said it looked like it was written by a child.
